name: netdust-agent
description: Netdust two-layer agent harness — a SKELETON layer (steps, gates, ordering: the harnessed-development intake router → two spines meeting at an enforced seam: planning (brainstorm→spec→plan+gates→analyze, stops at an approved gate-checked tasks.md) and building (refuses to start without that artifact; execute→test→review→shake-out→finish, owns the armed /loop). Building Stage 2 runs the test/dev split: an independent test-author writes each task’s RED test from the contract before the implementer greens it — no agent grades its own homework; plus the gates the spines fire: testing-workflow, threat-modeling, architecture-invariants, feature-acceptance, test-effectiveness, shake-out, compounding, standards-gate; with writing-plans + finishing-a-branch deferred to their superpowers bases and the process retro to the /evaluate command) and a CRAFT layer (gerund-named how-to the harness reaches for at each step: writing-tests, designing-apis, building-frontend, engineering-context, versioning-with-git, driving-the-browser, refining-ideas, sourcing-from-docs, doubting-decisions, simplifying-code, deploying; plus the dev-stack infra skill). Naming convention: gerund = craft (how), phase/gate noun = harness (when/whether). Optional spec-kit graft: gate-bearing spec/plan/tasks override templates + deterministic gate-check.py + per-project installer in spec-kit/, the spec-authoring/spec-analysis/constitution-bridge skills, and /spec-kit-setup; SubagentStop also backstops the standards gate — keystone: the handoff is tasks.md, /speckit.implement is never run (see docs/spec-kit-integration-adr.md). Adds run-observability: an in-loop event trace (run-trace.py, single-writer convergence point) + a deterministic evaluator rubric (run-score.py) graded from documented thresholds, surfaced in /shakeout and pointed to by /evaluate — report-only, zero new gates. Built on superpowers (base) + addyosmani/agent-skills (craft fills, MIT) with Netdust discipline as the authoritative spine. Standalone and self-contained — the full harness, specialist reviewer agents, hooks, and commands all live here, with no dependency on any other Netdust plugin.
